sources.title: Proclamation No. 1006, Declaring the Regular Holidays and Special (Non-Working) Days for the Year 2026 (3 September 2025) (The Lawphil Project)
sources.said: A. Regular Holidays: New Year's Day - 1 January (Thursday); Maundy Thursday - 2 April; Good Friday - 3 April; Araw ng Kagitingan - 9 April (Thursday); Labor Day - 1 May (Friday); Independence Day - 12 June (Friday); National Heroes Day - 31 August (Last Monday of August); Bonifacio Day - 30 November (Monday); Christmas Day - 25 December (Friday); Rizal Day - 30 December (Wednesday). B. Special (Non-Working) Days: Ninoy Aquino Day - 21 August (Friday); All Saints' Day - 1 November (Sunday); Feast of the Immaculate Conception of Mary - 8 December (Tuesday); Last Day of the Year - 31 December (Thursday). C. Special (Working) Day: EDSA People Power Revolution Anniversary - 25 February (Wednesday). D. Additional Special (Non-Working) Days: Chinese New Year - 17 February (Tuesday); Black Saturday - 4 April; All Souls' Day - 2 November (Monday); Christmas Eve - 24 December (Thursday). Section 2. The proclamations declaring national holidays for the observance of Eidul Fitr and Eidul Adha shall hereafter be issued after the approximate dates of the Islamic holidays have been determined ...

sources.title: Proclamation No. 1427, Declaring the Regular Holidays and Special (Non-Working) Days for the Year 2027 (8 September 2026), the pattern held to (The Lawphil Project)
sources.said: A. Regular Holidays: New Year's Day - 1 January; Maundy Thursday - 25 March; Good Friday - 26 March; Araw ng Kagitingan - 9 April; Labor Day - 1 May; Independence Day - 12 June; National Heroes Day - 30 August; Bonifacio Day - 30 November; Christmas Day - 25 December; Rizal Day - 30 December. B. Special (Non-Working) Days: Ninoy Aquino Day - 21 August; All Saints' Day - 1 November; Feast of the Immaculate Conception of Mary - 8 December; Last Day of the Year - 31 December. C. Special (Working) Day: EDSA People Power Revolution Anniversary - 25 February. Additional Special (Non-Working) Days: Chinese New Year - 06 February; Black Saturday - 27 March; All Souls' Day - 02 November; Christmas Eve - 24 December. (The Eids by later proclamations.)

sources.title: Proclamation No. 1189, Declaring Friday, 20 March 2026, a Regular Holiday Throughout the Country in Observance of Eid'l Fitr (The Lawphil Project)
sources.said: do hereby declare Friday, 20 March 2026, a regular holiday throughout the country in observance of Eid'l Fitr (Feast of Ramadhan).

sources.title: Proclamation No. 1264, Declaring Wednesday, 27 May 2026, a Regular Holiday Throughout the Country, in Observance of the Eidl Adha (The Lawphil Project)
sources.said: do hereby declare Wednesday, 27 May 2026, a regular holiday throughout the country, in observance of Eid'l Adha.

sources.title: Proclamation No. 1447, Declaring 16 - 18 November 2026 as Special (Non-Working) Days in the National Capital Region (The Lawphil Project)
sources.said: WHEREAS, the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits will be held in the National Capital Region ... do hereby declare 16 - 18 November 2026, as special (non-working) days in the National Capital Region.

sources.title: Proclamation No. 1334, Declaring Wednesday, 15 July 2026, A Special (Non-Working) Day in the Cordillera Administrative Region (The Lawphil Project)
sources.said: WHEREAS, on 15 July 2026, Wednesday, the Cordillera Administrative Region will mark the celebration of its 39th Founding Anniversary ... do hereby declare Wednesday, 15 July 2026, a special (non-working) day in the Cordillera Administrative Region.

sources.title: Proclamation No. 1389, Declaring Friday, 11 September 2026, a Special (Non-working) Day in the Cordillera Administrative Region (The Lawphil Project)
sources.said: WHEREAS, the Cordillera Administrative Region will mark the celebration of the Sipat Anniversary on 13 September 2026, which falls on a Sunday ... do hereby declare Friday, 11 September 2026, a special (non-working) day in the Cordillera Administrative Region.

sources.title: Proclamation No. 1395, Declaring Monday, 14 September 2026, a Special (Non-Working) Day in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (The Lawphil Project)
sources.said: WHEREAS, Republic Act (RA) No. 12317 ... reset the first BARMM Parliamentary Elections on ... 14 September 2026 ... do hereby declare Monday, 14 September 2026, a special (non-working) day in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao.

sources.title: Bangsamoro Information Office, Parliament approves bill regulating declaration of holidays in BARMM (22 July 2023): the Bangsamoro Holidays Act of 2023
sources.said: Under BTA Bill No. 192 ... Regular non-working holidays: Bangsamoro Foundation Day – January 21; Eid’l Fit’r – Shawwal 1; Eid’l Adha – Dul Al-Hijjah 10; Day of Shuhada – March 18. Special non-working holidays: Day of Arafah – 9th day of Dhul Hijjah; 1st Day of Tashriq – 11th day of Dhul Hijjah. (In force: the Bangsamoro Information Office, 18 March 2025: "Under the same law, March 18 is declared the Day of Shuhada, which is among the legislation’s regular non-working holidays.")

sources.title: SunStar, Barmm to observe 3 Islamic holidays (May 2026)
sources.said: Under Proclamation No. 0003, Series of 2026, issued by the Office of the Chief Minister, May 26 was declared a special non-working holiday for the observance of the Day of Arafah, while May 27 was declared a regular non-working holiday for Eid’l Adha or the Feast of Sacrifice. Meanwhile, May 28 was declared a special non-working holiday for the first day of Tashriq.
